issues.detail: The Hebrew says the king of Assyria had heard that he (the king) had departed from Lachish (כִּי שָׁמַע כִּי נָסַע מִלָּכִישׁ). The Vietnamese says 'Líp-na đã bỏ La-ki' (Libnah had abandoned Lachish), which makes Libnah the subject of the departure, whereas the Hebrew subject is the king of Assyria departing from Lachish. This changes who is doing what.
